topic.source_contract: DfT annual road-traffic estimates, count points and quality evidence

facts.guard: national totals are not site traffic capacity

facts.method: about 7000 manual counts plus automatic counters and road lengths
facts.quality: link and small-area estimates less robust
facts.guard: annual estimate is not a candidate transport assessment
estimated links require caution and local evidence may be better
API capability is not an executed candidate query
annual and provisional series must not be silently merged

scope_guards: National and regional traffic estimates are not site-specific traffic counts or junction capacity.
Counted and estimated count-point records remain distinct.
Annual Average Daily Flow is an annualised estimate and not an hourly peak-flow survey.
A count point must be matched to the correct road link and year.
Minor-road and small-area estimates can be less robust than strategic-network totals.
Annual, provisional and local-highway datasets must not be silently merged.
Traffic volume is not planning permission, road access right or development capacity.
No score or promotion is written without exact count point, method, year, local survey, junction and planning evidence.
